mn62:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn62:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn62:2.2: āyasmāpi kho rāhulo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
mn62:3.1: atha kho bhagavā apaloketvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi
mn62:3.2: yaṅkiñci rāhula rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbanti.
mn62:3.3: rūpameva nu kho bhagavā rūpameva nu kho sugatāti.
mn62:3.4: rūpampi rāhula vedanāpi rāhula saññāpi rāhula saṅkhārāpi rāhula viññāṇampi rāhulāti.
mn62:4.1: atha kho āyasmā rāhulo ko nujja bhagavatā sammukhā ovādena ovadito gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisissatīti tato paṭinivattitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn62:5.1: addasā kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā
mn62:5.4: ānāpānasati rāhula bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsāti.
mn62:6.1: atha kho āyasmā rāhulo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rāhulo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn62:7.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā nu kho bhante ānāpānasati kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsāti.
mn62:8.1: yaṅkiñci rāhula rūpaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ seyyathīdaṃ
mn62:8.2: kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nhārū aṭṭhī aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ
mn62:8.4: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā paṭhavīdhātu yā ca bāhirā paṭhavīdhātu paṭhavīdhāturevesā.
mn62:8.5: taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn62:8.6: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā paṭhavīdhātuyā nibbindati paṭhavīdhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn62:9.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ seyyathīdaṃ
mn62:9.5: pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttaṃ yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ
mn62:9.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā āpodhātu yā ca bāhirā āpodhātu āpodhāturevesā.
mn62:9.8: taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn62:9.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā āpodhātuyā nibbindati āpodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn62:10.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ seyyathīdaṃ
mn62:10.5: yena ca santapati yena ca jīrati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ
mn62:10.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā tejodhātu yā ca bāhirā tejodhātu tejodhāturevesā.
mn62:10.8: taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn62:10.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā tejodhātuyā nibbindati tejodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn62:11.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ seyyathīdaṃ
mn62:11.5: uddhaṅgamā vātā adhogamā vātā kucchisayā vātā koṭṭhasayā vātā aṅgamaṅgānusārino vātā assāso passāso yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ
mn62:11.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā vāyodhātu yā ca bāhirā vāyodhātu vāyodhāturevesā.
mn62:11.8: taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn62:11.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā vāyodhātuyā nibbindati vāyodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn62:12.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ upādinnaṃ seyyathīdaṃ
mn62:12.5: kaṇṇacchidaṃ nāsacchiddaṃ mukhadvāraṃ yena ca asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ ajjhoharati yattha ca asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ saṃtiṭṭhati yena ca asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ adhobhāgā nikkhamati yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaraṃ vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ maṃsalohitehi ajjhattaṃ upādinnaṃ
mn62:12.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu yā ca bāhirā ākāsadhātu ākāsadhāturevesā.
mn62:12.8: taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn62:12.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā ākāsadhātuyā nibbindati ākāsadhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
